description: Returns the MORVS License Plate Reader Register's full state-law research record for one US state or DC, including official law citations and URLs, checked date, verification status, retention and sharing provisions, exceptions and search limitations. A "none_found" or unverified status describes the sources checked; it does not prove that no applicable law exists. Verify the current official text before relying on a provision.

state.description: Required two-letter USPS state code. A none_found, not_verified card means not verified; it does not establish no law.

name: plate_reader_state_law
title: Get Plate Reader State Law
